THIS CONTRACT is made and entered into this first day of January 2013, by and
between Laramie County Community Partnership, Inc.(hereinafter referred to as“LCCP"), 910

1328 Talbot Court, Cheyenne, Wyoming (hereinafter referred to as “City").
WITNESS:
WHEREAS LCC P desires to enterinto a Contract with the City topurchase services to
be provided by the City pursuant to the terms and conditions of this Contract; and
WHEREAS THE PAYMENT obligations of LCCPunder this Contract are contingent
upon receipt by LCC P of 21Century Community Learning Centers(hereinafter referred to as
“"21CCLC") Cohort Five (5) grant funds, CFD #84.287C, from the Wyoming Department of
Education (hereinafter referred to as“Department").
NOW THEREFORE:
1.THE CITY hereby agrees to:
a.Provide a range of academic and other enrichment activities to at-risk school-age
youth at Laramie County School District #1, Carey Junior High,1780 East
Pershing Boulevard, Cheyenne, Wyomingand their families outside the regular
school day and during periods when school is not in session as described in the
201221CCL C Work Plan&Budget(AttachmentA)tobe attached to this
Contract for Services upon approval from Department.

Generally Accepted Account Principles(GAAP), federal regulations and provide
financial reports as may be requested by LCCP. Additional required procedures
are attached to this document as AttachmentB.
c.Submit reports to LCCP as required by the Department no later than ten (10) days
before reports are due.
d.Submit to LCCP no later than April 4,2013 baseline information required to meet
the United States' Department of Education's Learning Point annual reporting

e.Implement the After-School Program Assessment System utilizing the evaluation

f.Take corrective action, within ten(1o)days or as specified by LCCP to remedy
any deficiencies deemed byLCCP tobe adversely affecting LCC P's adherence to
its compliance obligations.
g.Permit LCCP staff or its designees to conduct periodic on-site visits to the City's
program to observe, interact with staff, and review any documentation pertaining
to the City's compliance with this Contract.
h.Issue invoices according to federal regulations governing 21CCLC funding for
payment and reimbursement of grant funds. Invoices will be received in the
LCCP by the twentieth (2o"h) of month following expenditure of funds. Funds will
be expended at a consistent level throughout the year. All invoices shall be dated
and be signed by the City's Director; and
i.Perform such other tasks and/or provide such other information and
documentation as may be required by the LCCP or the Department.
2.THE LCCP hereby agrees to:
a.Monitor and evaluation the City's compliance with the terms of this Contract.
b. Monitor the performance of the City's program, including fiscal management, and
all other data detailed in written reports and site visits; and
c.Provide technical assistance and training to the City.

3.COMPENSATION.LCCP agrees to pay the City an amount not to exceed One Hundred
and Fifteen Thousand (115,000.00) for the performance of the above services. The City
will invoice LCCP in accordance with the City's prepared budget, as defined in the 2013
21CCLC Work Plan & Budget, a copy of which will be attached as Attachment A upon
approval from the Department, and incorporated herein by reference. LCCP shall not be
required to pay any invoice unless and until it receives the funds appliedfor from the
Department.Payment for reimbursement will made within thirty (30) days of receipt of
each in voice issued by the City.
4.TERM.The term of this Contract shall commence on the 1" day of January 2013 and
terminate on the 31" day of December 2013, unless earlier terminated as set forth in
paragraph seven(7) of this Contract.
5.CITY'S CONTACT PERSON.Dick Berry, Director of Cheyenne Office of Youth
Alternatives, 1328 Talbot Court, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82001.
6.PROOF OF INSURANCE. City provides liability coverage in accordance with the
Wyoming Governmental Claims Act (WGCA).A certification of such coverage will be
provided toLCCP.
7. TERMINATION. If, through any cause, the City shall fail to fulfill in a timely and proper
manner, its obligations under this Contract; or if the City violates any of the covenants,
agreements, or stipulations of the Contract; LCCP may terminate this Contract if such
default or violation is not correction within thirty (30) days following City's receipt of
anynoticeof a violation issued byLCCP.
8.CHANGES. By mutual written agreement, LCCP and the City may from time to time
amend the Scope of Services to be performed by the City under this Contract.
